'''Navreek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as part of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] where he sold equipment to [[Imperial Agent|Imperial agents]].
